result.summary: PASS on the §2.2/§2.3 delta (commit 4d63a6a1). Idiom/style: sync_role_claims_from_token/3 and resolve_group_ids_for_role_names/2 match neighboring Identity.ex conventions exactly -- reuses insert_or_fetch_group_member/3 at its lean private arity (not add_group_member/3's public wrapper) as the design specified, wraps the group-membership inserts + marker stamp in one Ecto.Multi/Repo.transaction (Multi already aliased at identity.ex:63, used the same way at several other sites in this module for same-transaction guarantees), and follows RoleRegistry's documented 'seeding/lookup helpers never fail the caller's flow' convention (fail-open to the original unmodified user on any transaction error, logged via Logger.error/1, self-healing since the marker stays nil and the next request retries). resolve_group_ids_for_role_names/2 stays in Identity rather than RoleRegistry for the same 'no coupling to OIDC/claim-mapping pipeline' reason list_effective_role_names/2 already does -- consistent, not a new exception. Migration (20260921000001_add_role_claims_synced_at_to_users.exs) matches a real sibling's convention (compared against 20260917000001_create_help_content.exs): same header-comment shape (REQ id, rationale, explicit tenant-scoped-migration callout), same `if prefix() do` guard, same registration requirement called out in both the migration header and tenant_provisioning.ex, `null: true`/no default/no backfill correctly reasoned (existing rows land NULL = 'not yet synced', which is exactly correct per design §2.2.1/§2.2.4). No scope creep: implementation matches design §2.2.1-2.2.4 point for point (new column, sync function's 4 numbered steps, both call sites, the marker-gate safety argument) and §2.3's three test corrections are exactly what that section calls for, nothing more. Diff-verified (not trust): each of the 3 named test files (auth_pipeline_test.exs:167, api_pipeline_integration_test.exs:130, req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs:1053) shows exactly 1 insertion/1 deletion in `git show 4d63a6a1`, changing only `roles == ["VIEWER"]` to `roles == []` on the named line -- no other lines touched in any of the three files. Two follow-up issues to file post-merge, per SECURITY-REVIEWER's step-03b-rework1 handoff, explicitly listed here for ORCH: (1) lib/letflow/plugs/tenant_status.ex:92-95 raw-role-check hygiene issue (pre-existing, out of this delta's scope, flagged by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR rework3 and disposed by SECURITY-REVIEWER as separate work); (2) the earlier-flagged groupsApi.addMembers/.list/.get/.update/.delete/.members broken-prefix sibling bug (frontend, pre-existing, out of this delta's scope).
